description: Entirely fictional, author-written short document excerpts. Training and test excerpts are distinct; these are not real resident records or representative accuracy evidence.

benefit-notice: FICTIONAL County CalFresh notice of expiration. Return your renewal application. Your certification period will end. Complete the interview with the county.
Practice CalFresh information verification needed CF377.6. Please provide requested items by the due date. County eligibility worker and case number.
County benefit notice. Your application for food assistance requires verification. Requested documents include income proof. Call your eligibility worker.
CalFresh recertification CF377.2. Certification expires. Submit the renewal form to the county social services office before the deadline.
Department of social services notice of action. Your benefits may stop. Contact your county case worker and review the hearing instructions.
CalFresh interview appointment. Your telephone interview is scheduled. Have requested verification ready and contact your county eligibility worker.
Medi-Cal renewal notice. Review your household information and return the renewal packet to your county. Benefits and case number.
Eligibility notice: county needs more information to process your benefit application. Return selected verification and review the due date.
AVISO DE PRÁCTICA CalFresh. Condado de Santa Clara. Su período de certificación termina. Devuelva la solicitud de renovación y complete la entrevista.
Aviso de información y verificación necesaria CF377.6. Presente los documentos solicitados antes de la fecha límite. Trabajador de elegibilidad del condado.
Aviso de renovación de beneficios CalFresh. Su caso necesita una entrevista con servicios sociales del condado. Número de caso y fecha de vencimiento.
Condado de San Mateo aviso de acción. Revise su solicitud de asistencia y la fecha límite. Llame al trabajador de su caso.
Aviso de renovación Medi-Cal. Complete el paquete de renovación y envíelo a la oficina del condado. Información sobre sus beneficios.
Cita de entrevista CalFresh. La oficina de elegibilidad del condado solicita verificación para su caso. Revise la fecha y sus beneficios.
